title: Outdated jQuery 1.12.4 with known XSS issues
notes:
The storefront loads jQuery 1.12.4 from /static/js/jquery-1.12.4.min.js.
This version is affected by CVE-2020-11022 and CVE-2020-11023 (XSS in htmlPrefilter). No exploitable sink was confirmed yet.
